desc: negative: Try to redirect to self on egress with clsact
pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.10.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 clsact
tc filter add dev dummy1 egress protocol ip prio 10 matchall action mirred egress redirect dev dummy1 index 1

readback.cmd: tc -j -s actions get action mirred index 1
readback.name: verify
